QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_18

question.text: SAS 1300 covers the thematic area of:

answer.text: Facilitating access to land and property assets for disadvantaged communities
Protection of national heritage, art, and culture

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.5 maps SAS 1300 to 'Promotion of financial inclusion'. Incubator support is SAS 800; land/property access is SAS 1400; heritage/art/culture is SAS 600. The Trap: B (SAS 800), C (SAS 1400), D (SAS 600) are each distinct standards. Financial inclusion is cleanly SAS 1300.
